title: No-Show Recovery Board
oneLiner: A clinic revenue recovery dashboard that prioritizes high-risk appointments and the fastest actions to refill open slots.
targetUser: Clinic operators, front-desk leads, and appointment revenue teams.
keyUX: See which appointments are most likely to no-show, identify the best backfill candidates, and launch the highest-value outreach action in one place.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop clinic revenue recovery dashboard called No-Show Recovery Board for local clinics and appointment operations teams. It should help staff reduce revenue loss by identifying high-risk appointments, prioritizing outreach, and filling open slots with the best replacement candidates before the schedule breaks. Include a revenue recovery KPI hero, a high-risk appointment queue, a patient context timeline, a replacement slot panel, an outreach action drawer, and a daily recovered revenue rail. Design direction: use a premium care-ops aesthetic with warm stone, clean white, muted teal, and understated brass accents; keep the interface elegant but highly scannable, with editorial card composition and calm operational clarity.
